Maya (CSE): heads up — Cinder Labs cohort kickoff next Wed. low usage from 2 of 5 seats, want to run 45m feedback + enablement. Any blockers?
Alex (AE): noted. I pinged their PM (Irene) — they have a scheduled maintenance Tue which may be why. :calendar:
Priya (Solutions Eng): I can cover integration checklist. Can someone share latest enablement deck link?
Maya (CSE): deck here: https://docs.redwood.ai/cs/cinder_enablement_v2 — needs one slide added on retry/backoff behavior. Also usage: they've been calling small models only, suggest showing quantization tradeoffs.
Devon (Product Ops): FYI product saw a small perf regression on 2026-03-15 deploy, might affect latency for longer prompts. Not widespread but flagging.
Sam (CS Manager): That regression could be a renewal risk if demo shows lag. Let's confirm: Maya -> can you run quick smoke with their sample prompt and paste logs?
Maya (CSE): running now, attaching snippet:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/generate -d '{"model":"rw-v1","input":"<sample>"}'
-> latency 380ms, 200 OK
```
Maya (CSE): seems OK on our env. Their region is eu-west-1 though.
Priya (Solutions Eng): I'll prep a short 10-min slideset + live demo script. Can we make the session 3pm UTC on Wed? That's 11am PT.
Alex (AE): that's fine for me. Maya, can you invite, include meeting agenda + ask them to fill pre-call feedback form: https://forms.redwood.ai/cinder-beta-feedback
Maya (CSE): invite sent. Also adding action items:
- Priya: enablement slides + demo script
- Devon: short note for product on regressed paths
- Alex: confirm attendee list
- Maya: pre-call metrics + runbook
Devon (Product Ops): I'll drop a one-paragraph note on the perf regression and include mitigation steps. ETA EOD Tue.
onboard-bot: Reminder: schedule created for 2026-03-25 15:00 UTC — calendar invite sent to participants.
Sam (CS Manager): Great. After the session we'll collect the feedback and decide if we need a deeper technical workshop. :white_check_mark:
